entities.name: Tim
entities.description: One of the two speakers, and John's friend; they met on 21 May 2023 and talked every few weeks until January 2024. A student and a lifelong fantasy-fiction reader — Harry Potter above all, and Game of Thrones — who runs a Harry Potter fan project, joined a fantasy literature forum in June 2023, wrote articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine from August 2023, was drafting his own fantasy novel by October 2023, took up the piano in August 2023 and the violin in December 2023, joined a travel club, started learning German, and was accepted for a study-abroad semester in Galway in January 2024. He has never played on a sports team.

entities.name: John
entities.description: One of the two speakers, and Tim's friend; a professional basketball player. A shooting guard who signed with the Minnesota Wolves on 21 May 2023, having played since he was ten, through high school and on a college scholarship before being drafted. He won a Nike deal in July 2023, married in the week before 2 October 2023, mentors the younger players on his team, works with a charity for youth sports, and surfs, hikes, cooks, does yoga and travels. He was injured in November 2023 and was still in rehabilitation in December.

entities.name: Minnesota Wolves
entities.description: The professional basketball team John signed with on 21 May 2023 and plays shooting guard for. He calls it a second family; the squad won a trophy by October 2023 and the team-mates gave him a signed basketball on 15 August 2023. Referred to both as the Minnesota Wolves and simply the Wolves.

entities.name: basketball
entities.description: The sport John plays professionally and has played since his father signed him up for a local league at ten. He practises and trains every day, credits strength training for his shooting accuracy, and says he cannot imagine his life without it.

entities.name: Harry Potter

properties.aliases: HP; the wizarding world; the Potter books

entities.description: The book and film series at the centre of Tim's life: his favourite books, the subject of his fan project, of a conference he went to in the UK, of a themed Christmas tree and of the December 2023 party he went to. He owns a MinaLima print of props from the films and has seen every film; his favourite is the first, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, which he watched with his family. John knows the films too and owns the whole collection.

entities.name: Tim's Harry Potter fan project
entities.description: A fan project about the Harry Potter universe that Tim was working on when he met John in May 2023, discussing collaborations with other fans about characters, spells and magical creatures. In August 2023 he talked with a Harry Potter fan in California about possibly collaborating on it.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city where Tim visited a Harry Potter attraction and went on a tour a few years before May 2023, an experience he described as like walking into a Harry Potter film.

entities.name: United Kingdom
entities.description: The country Tim travels to for Harry Potter and for castles: a Harry Potter attraction and tour in London a few years before 2023, a Harry Potter conference in the week before 13 October 2023, a book about British castles, and a castle he visited on 10 November 2023. He later tried to write a story based on the trip.

entities.name: John's sneaker collection
entities.description: A collection of trainers John keeps and loves talking to people about, mentioned when he and Tim first spoke on 21 May 2023.

entities.name: the fantasy literature forum
entities.description: An online forum for fantasy fiction that Tim joined on the night of 14 June 2023. It is where he found the opportunity to write articles for an online fantasy magazine, which he pitched in the summer of 2023.

entities.name: Nike
entities.description: A sports brand. John named it in June 2023 as one he hoped to work with and signed a basketball shoe and gear deal with it on 16 July 2023 — his first endorsement.

entities.name: Under Armour
entities.description: A sports brand John has always liked and said in June and July 2023 he would love to work with. No deal with it is reported in the conversation.

entities.name: Gatorade
entities.description: A sports drink brand John said on 16 July 2023 he was in talks with about a potential sponsorship. The conversation never says whether it was signed; an endorsement he announced in January 2024 was with an unnamed beverage company.

entities.name: Tim's book collection
entities.description: The shelves of fantasy novels Tim shows John repeatedly — in June 2023, August 2023, October 2023 and again after he reorganised them on 1 December 2023. A MinaLima print hangs with them, and Harry Potter and Game of Thrones are the heart of the collection.

entities.name: Tim's MinaLima print
entities.description: A picture by MinaLima, the studio that made the props for the Harry Potter films, which hangs with Tim's bookshelf. He showed it to John on 15 June 2023 and called it like having a piece of the wizarding world at home.

entities.name: the Harry Potter fan Tim met in California

properties.aliases: that Harry Potter fan I met in CA; a fellow fan

entities.description: A Harry Potter enthusiast Tim met and talked with in California in the week before 16 July 2023, and spoke to again over Skype on 9 August 2023 about characters and a possible collaboration. Never named in the conversation.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where Tim met the fellow Harry Potter fan he talked with in July 2023 and Skyped in August 2023.

entities.name: Seattle
entities.description: One of John's favourite cities to explore, where he had a game in August 2023. He loves its energy, diversity, seafood and the support of fans there; Tim said he had always wanted to try the seafood.

entities.name: surfing
entities.description: A sport John took up about five years before July 2023 and does with friends in the summer. He values the connection to nature it gives him; Tim does not surf and says reading fantasy gives him the same freedom.

entities.name: reading fantasy fiction
entities.description: Tim's central pastime and, he says, his escape from reality — reading Harry Potter, Game of Thrones, Patrick Rothfuss and other fantasy, and the reason he writes about it. He also reads books on growth, psychology and self-improvement. John reads far less but took it up again after their talks.

entities.name: writing about and writing fantasy
entities.description: Tim's other craft: articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine from August 2023, and his own fantasy novel from 2023 onwards. He takes notes on J.K. Rowling's style and draws ideas from books, films and his own travels.

entities.name: the online fantasy magazine Tim writes for
entities.description: An online magazine that took up Tim's pitch in the summer of 2023 and publishes his articles about fantasy novels — character studies, themes and book recommendations. Never named; he found the opportunity through the fantasy literature forum.

entities.name: Game of Thrones

properties.aliases: GoT; A Song of Ice and Fire

entities.description: One of Tim's two favourite series alongside Harry Potter, named in August 2023 and still his favourite in November 2023. He has read the whole series, finished A Dance with Dragons in December 2023, and wrote an analysis of a series for his English literature class that month.

entities.name: Anthony
entities.description: A friend of John's who went with him to a charity event featuring a fiercely contested Harry Potter trivia contest, which John recounted on 2 August 2023 and referred back to in December.

entities.name: The Name of the Wind
entities.description: A fantasy novel by Patrick Rothfuss with a magician and musician as its protagonist. Tim was reading it in August 2023, praised its world-building and characters, recommended it to John for his travels in September 2023, and was reading it again in January 2024.

entities.name: Patrick Rothfuss
entities.description: The author of The Name of the Wind, the fantasy novel Tim recommended to John repeatedly between August 2023 and January 2024.

entities.name: Chicago
entities.description: The city John travelled to in the days before 11 August 2023. He loved its energy and found the locals friendly; he rejoined his team-mates on 15 August after the trip.

entities.name: John's lucky basketball shoes
entities.description: The basketball shoes John has worn since the beginning of his career, which he showed Tim on 11 August 2023. He says every mark has a story and that they stand for resilience, determination and his love of the game.

entities.name: John's father
entities.description: John's father, who watched NBA games with him when he was a boy and signed him up for a local basketball league when he turned ten — the start of his career.

entities.name: the youth sports organization John works with
entities.description: A local organization helping disadvantaged children with sport and school, which John said on 11 August 2023 he was teaming up with. His charity work grew from it: fair chances in sport for underserved communities, a basketball camp in his hometown, and a benefit game in January 2024. Never named.

entities.name: the basketball John's team-mates signed for him
entities.description: A basketball covered in his team-mates' autographs, given to John when he met back up with them on 15 August 2023. He keeps it as a reminder of their friendship and of why he started playing.

entities.name: the gym John trains at
entities.description: The gym John found in the days before 21 August 2023 to keep up his fitness for professional basketball. Finding it was hard and adapting his routine to it harder; it is also where he jogged without pain for the first time after his injury, on 15 December 2023.

entities.name: strength training
entities.description: The half of John's routine that is not basketball. He balances the two on a written workout plan and says strength training builds muscle, prevents injuries, makes him more explosive and improved his shooting accuracy, agility and speed.

entities.name: playing the piano
entities.description: Tim started learning the piano on or about 21 August 2023 and said on 6 December 2023 he had been playing about four months. His favourite thing to play is a theme from Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone.

entities.name: Tim's family
entities.description: A group entity for Tim's family, whom he never names individually. They watched the first Harry Potter film together with snacks and a blanket, gather for Thanksgiving to cook and say what they are thankful for, and watch Home Alone, Elf and The Santa Clause over the holidays. Tim counts their support as one of the things he is most grateful for.

entities.name: John's family
entities.description: A group entity for John's family, whom he never names individually apart from his father and his wife. They get together often, he visited home and caught up with them and old friends in the week before 26 August 2023, and he says they are always there for him. They celebrated his recovery milestone with him in December 2023.

entities.name: Tim's school
entities.description: The school or college Tim attends, never named. It is the source of the assignments, exams and projects that recur through the conversation — an overwhelming week in August 2023, a class presentation on 30 August 2023, a tough English literature class in December 2023 — and of the study-abroad place in Galway he won in January 2024.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: John's way of relaxing away from the court, which he calls therapy. He improvises — a butternut soup with sage in August 2023 — and has favourites such as honey garlic chicken with roasted vegetables; he brought a cookbook back from Italy in December 2023.

entities.name: New York City
entities.description: A city John visited before August 2023 and calls a must-visit for its culture, food and restaurants; his only trouble there was working out the subway until somebody explained it. Tim put it on his travel list.

entities.name: Universal Studios
entities.description: The theme park Tim said on 31 August 2023 he was planning to visit the following month, his first time, mainly for the Harry Potter attractions. John has never been and has it on his bucket list.

entities.name: John's hometown
entities.description: The town John grew up in and goes back to, never named. He visited home and old friends in the week before 26 August 2023, ran a week-long basketball camp for local children in the summer of 2023, and photographed a tranquil forest near it.

entities.name: John's wife
entities.description: The woman John married in the week before 2 October 2023 at a greenhouse venue, never named in the conversation. She and John had their first dance at a cosy restaurant, left for a European holiday on 6 November 2023 and road-tripped along the European coastline, and hosted a get-together with friends and family in December 2023 to celebrate his first pain-free jog after his injury. She also travelled to Italy with him in December 2023.

entities.name: LeBron James
entities.description: The basketball player both John and Tim name as their favourite. John admires his skills, leadership and work ethic, has met him a few times and found him easy-going, and has seen him play live. Tim's prized possession is a basketball signed by him, and Tim was inspired by his chase-down block in the 2016 Finals, which John identified as Game 7 against Iguodala.

entities.name: J.K. Rowling
entities.description: The author of the Harry Potter books and Tim's greatest writing inspiration. He has read her work for a long time, takes notes on her style for his own novel, and keeps a quote of hers — "Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times" — as a way of holding on to hope.

entities.name: Tim's fantasy novel
entities.description: The fantasy novel Tim is writing. He was in the middle of the draft on 21 October 2023 and called it nerve-wracking but exciting; in the week before 6 November 2023 he got stuck on a plot twist and pushed through it; in the week before 21 November 2023 a story he tried to base on his UK trip did not come out the way he wanted. His inspiration comes from books, films, his travels and J.K. Rowling's style.

entities.name: John's injury
entities.description: The injury that kept John off the basketball court from around 16 November 2023. His doctor said it was not too serious; he hated not playing, did physical therapy exercises every day, and jogged without pain for the first time on 15 December 2023. He separately described hurting his ankle in an earlier season and recovering from it with time off and physical therapy, which may or may not be the same injury — he spoke of that one in the past tense on 21 November 2023 while this one was still current.

entities.name: yoga
entities.description: John took up yoga by 1 December 2023 to add strength and flexibility, and said it had also improved his focus and balance in workouts. Warrior II is a pose he enjoys because it makes him feel strong, and he holds his favourite leg-and-core pose for 30 to 60 seconds.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: Something both men do. John joined a hiking club shortly before his wedding in autumn 2023, found the river-and-rocks spot from his outdoor-gear photoshoot while out hiking, and got hiking gear in that December 2023 deal. Tim lists hiking with friends and family among his favourite things to do.

entities.name: John's hiking club
entities.description: A hiking club John had only just joined when he married in the week before 2 October 2023; some of its members came to the wedding. Never named.

entities.name: The Alchemist
entities.description: A novel both men have read and rate highly. Tim spotted it on John's bookshelf on 21 September 2023 and called it one of his favourites; John said it made him think about following his dreams, and had finished rereading it shortly before 21 November 2023, finding it motivating and hopeful. Tim read it a while back and said it changed his perspective on his goals.

entities.name: The Hobbit
entities.description: A fantasy novel John named on 1 December 2023 as one of his favourites, when Tim showed him his newly reorganised bookshelf.

entities.name: Tim's signed basketball
entities.description: A basketball signed by Tim's favourite player, LeBron James, which he keeps in a case and calls his prized possession and a reminder of all the hard work. He showed it to John on 6 November 2023.

entities.name: Edinburgh
entities.description: The Scottish city Tim suggested on 21 September 2023 as a destination for the Minnesota Wolves' team trip, calling it the birthplace of Harry Potter and praising its history, architecture and magical feel. John had never been and said it was worth considering.

entities.name: Europe
entities.description: Where John and his wife took a short holiday, leaving on 6 November 2023. They road-tripped along the European coastline, which he described on 11 November 2023 as spectacular and a welcome change from his ordinary life. He was in Italy in December 2023 and has also been to Paris.

entities.name: the Smoky Mountains
entities.description: Where Tim took the sunset photograph he showed John on 17 October 2023, on a trip he made the previous year. He said seeing it in person was incredible.

entities.name: the Rocky Mountains
entities.description: Where John took a trip the year before December 2023. He showed Tim photographs of the snow-capped peaks on 1 December 2023 and said the mountains and the fresh air made him realise how incredible the world is.

entities.name: Tim's travel club

properties.aliases: a group of globetrotters; fellow travel enthusiasts

entities.description: A club of travellers Tim joined on 6 December 2023 out of a long-standing interest in other cultures and countries, and which he described again on 2 January 2024 as a group of globetrotters whose trips he enjoys hearing about. Never named. His travel plans through the winter — the book of travellers' stories, the travel agency visit, the visa research — run alongside it.

entities.name: playing the violin
entities.description: The second instrument Tim took up, having started shortly before 6 December 2023. He is mostly into classical music but keen to try jazz and film scores, and calls it a way to relax and be creative. John said he hoped to hear him play one day.

entities.name: learning German
entities.description: The language Tim was learning as of 2 January 2024. He finds it tough but worth it, likes the structure of the language, and says it comes easier than the French he took in high school. John knows a bit of German himself and had just started Spanish; both use the same language app.

entities.name: Dune
entities.description: The novel by Frank Herbert that John was reading on 8 December 2023 and recommended to Tim, describing it as a great story about religion and human control over ecology. Tim had not read it but had heard good things.

entities.name: Frank Herbert
entities.description: The author of Dune, the novel John was reading in December 2023.

entities.name: George R. R. Martin
entities.description: The author of the Game of Thrones series. Tim has read that series of his and no other of his books; John had not read any as of 8 December 2023 but said he would check them out.

entities.name: the outdoor gear company John signed with
entities.description: A renowned outdoor gear company that signed John to an endorsement deal in the week before 19 December 2023 — hiking and outdoor kit plus a photoshoot in a forest. Never named.

entities.name: the beverage company John signed with
entities.description: A popular beverage company that John signed an endorsement with in the week before 12 January 2024, which he called a dream come true. Never named; it is not said to be the sports drink brand he was in talks with in July 2023.

entities.name: Emma Watson
entities.description: The lead actress in the Harry Potter films, whom Tim named for John on 26 December 2023. Tim is a huge fan and says her support for gender equality and advocacy for women's rights are a huge inspiration to him.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings
entities.description: The fantasy series both men name as a favourite: Tim called it his favourite on 26 December 2023, and John called himself a huge fan of it on 2 January 2024, loving the adventure, the world and the characters. John's favourite character is Aragorn and he keeps a painting in his room that reminds him to lead and stay true; Tim has a map of Middle-earth.

entities.name: Star Wars
entities.description: The film series Tim named on 2 January 2024 as his favourite, saying it never gets old. He had named The Lord of the Rings as his favourite a week earlier, on 26 December 2023.

entities.name: The Wheel of Time
entities.description: A fantasy television series due out in January 2024, based on a book series Tim loves. He told John on 26 December 2023 that he could not wait to see the books come to life on screen.

entities.name: Italy
entities.description: Where John spent time in December 2023, a trip he called awesome for the food, the history and the architecture. He brought a cookbook home from it that has been giving him cooking ideas. Tim has never been and has it on his list.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city John has visited and loved, telling Tim on 2 January 2024 that the view from the Eiffel Tower is incredible. Tim has not been and wants to see it.

entities.name: Barcelona
entities.description: The city John recommended to Tim on 12 January 2024 as a must-visit, for its culture, its architecture, the food in each neighbourhood and the nearby beaches. Tim added it to his travel list.

entities.name: Ireland
entities.description: Where Tim is going for a semester abroad from February 2024, having been accepted onto the programme on 5 January 2024. He will stay in Galway and wants to see the nature and the Cliffs of Moher.

entities.name: Galway
entities.description: The Irish city Tim will live in for his study-abroad semester from February 2024. He picked it for its arts, its Irish music and what he calls a vibrant atmosphere, and is most excited about exploring the nature around it.

entities.name: the Cliffs of Moher
entities.description: The Irish cliffs Tim said on 7 January 2024 he wants to visit during his semester in Galway, for the ocean views. John said he might stop by there after his season.
